name: Sigiriya Kingdom
Description: Sigiriya is a rock fortress built by King Kashyapa. It is famous for frescoes and advanced water gardens.

name: Sacred Tooth Relic Arrival
Description: The Sacred Tooth Relic was brought to Sri Lanka from India. It became a symbol of royal authority in Kandy.

name: Galle Fort Dutch Period
Description: Galle Fort was built by the Portuguese and expanded by the Dutch. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site with colonial architecture.

name: Anuradhapura Golden Age
Description: Anuradhapura was a thriving capital with great monasteries. The city grew into a center for Buddhism and architecture.
